neighbours.label: the adjective right before 'level' in 'on a X level' / 'at the X level' (predicts the word level)
fire: The film works on a purely emotional level, even if the plot is thin.
Teachers agreed that, on a practical level, the new timetable was a mess.
Policy changes are needed at the national level before anything improves.
I liked him on a personal level, though we disagreed about almost everything.
The project was coordinated at the regional level by three small agencies.
On a technical level, the camera is one of the best ever made.
Cooperation at the global level has slowed since the summit collapsed.
She was honest with me on so many levels that I still trust her.
quiet: The film is a purely emotional journey, even if the plot is thin.
Teachers agreed that, in practical terms, the new timetable was a mess.
Policy changes are needed from the national government before anything improves.
I liked him as a personal friend, though we disagreed about almost everything.
The project was coordinated by regional agencies with three small offices.
In technical terms, the camera is one of the best ever made.
Cooperation between global powers has slowed since the summit collapsed.
She was honest with me in so many ways that I still trust her.

notes: Card: peaks on ' many', ' political', ' personal', ' international' immediately before 'level'; output suppresses ' level'/' levels'.
